description: Return the full triage explainer for a single symptom by slug. Includes: what the symptom means, common causes, the lab work-up a clinician would order, and when the patient should seek urgent evaluation. The related marker and condition slug arrays let the upstream LLM follow the graph into mediora__explain_marker / explain_condition.

slug.description: Mediora canonical slug (e.g. 'hba1c', 'ferritin'). Use mediora__list_markers / mediora__list_conditions to discover slugs.

name: mediora__explain_symptom
title: Explain a symptom
